prompt: Count how many parts are on conveyor_in when the program starts (the line keeps feeding it, so the number changes every shift) and send that number to channel "ops" from arm_a.

paths.when: three parts are on conveyor_in: the number 3 is sent to ops
none is on conveyor_in: the number 0 is sent to ops

why: RoboLang 2.2 (0044 K1, D1): a `count` of the parts on conveyor_in (a location, D1), read by arm_a's camera and sent to ops as a value (1.6 V8). The request names no end state. Before L4 (2.1): A message is a fixed string. There are no variables, no counters and no way to read how many objects are somewhere, so a number measured at run time cannot be sent.
